name: Author Card
summary: Passive fail-closed identity composition for one target-supplied author, with optional canonical Avatar, role, full-only biography and author Links, intrinsic full/compact layout, and zero neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Neutral non-landmark container for exactly one author identity; omitted when name is empty.

anatomy.name: avatar
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Avatar composition with target-authored image or initials semantics.

anatomy.name: name
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible localized author name rendered as neutral text by the shared implementation.

anatomy.name: bio
anatomy.description: Optional plain-text biography rendered only in full presentation.

anatomy.name: links
anatomy.description: Optional wrapping group rendered only in full presentation.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Target-owned author destination composed from canonical Link.

variants.name: full
variants.description: Framed identity composition that renders every supplied optional part.

variants.name: compact
variants.description: Unframed concise Avatar, name and role row; biography and Links are omitted from its DOM.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One fluid intrinsic size; Avatar selects its own canonical semantic size independently.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive identity content with no selection, disabled, loading, interactive, controlled or uncontrolled state.

behavior.name: requiredIdentity
behavior.description: A non-empty visible name is required; missing or blank name omits the complete root rather than emitting an unidentified card.

behavior.name: hostSemantics
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses a div root and neutral name text. The consuming article owns contextual footer, aside, contact-only address, heading rank, author Link, structured data and placement semantics.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Visual identity composes canonical Avatar and destinations compose canonical native Links. Targets own image/initials alternatives, destinations, labels, target/rel security, author relationship and navigation.

behavior.name: compactOmission
behavior.description: Compact rendering omits biography and Links from the DOM instead of serializing permanently unavailable hidden content; defensive CSS still hides incompatible copied markup.

behavior.name: singleAuthor
behavior.description: One root represents one author. Targets repeat L6 in an appropriate semantic collection for multiple authors instead of passing a provider-specific collection API.

behavior.name: intrinsicResponse
behavior.description: Full presentation wraps from available inline size, strings and Links remain complete, and logical geometry avoids viewport coupling and document-level overflow.

behavior.name: targetDataPrivacy
behavior.description: Author source, localization, sanitization, email/homepage/social exposure, privacy, consent, analytics, SEO and provider policy remain target-owned.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: L6 owns no data fetch, listener, observer, timer, request, storage, live region, focus manager, fallback derivation, animation, asset or neutral JavaScript.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Full or compact presentation and content-density profile; full is classless.

properties.name: avatar
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the Avatar without generating an empty wrapper, image, initials or fallback.
properties.description: Optional canonical Avatar composition. The target explicitly supplies image or initials content, contextual alternative, semantic size, loading and fallback policy.

properties.name: name
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete root when the trimmed visible author name is empty.
properties.description: Required complete visible localized author name; neutral Web does not infer a heading rank or destination.

properties.name: role
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the role node and collapse its rhythm.
properties.description: Optional complete visible localized role or affiliation; this is content, not an ARIA role.

properties.name: bio
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the biography node; compact omits it even when a source value exists.
properties.description: Optional complete plain-text biography for full presentation. Rich authoring remains target-owned.

properties.name: links
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the destination group; compact omits it even when a source slot exists.
properties.description: Optional target-owned canonical author Links with complete labels, href values, native relationship/security attributes and privacy policy.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible author name and omit the complete root when it is absent; do not create an anonymous landmark or image-only identity.
Keep the neutral root out of the landmark and heading outline; the consuming article chooses a truthful footer, aside, contact-only address, heading rank or linked name when its context requires one.

Compose canonical Avatar and avoid repeating the adjacent visible name in image alternatives; targets provide contextual alt or a named image role only when the portrait adds unique identity information.
Use canonical native anchors with href for author destinations and Button only for actions; preserve clear localized purpose, target/rel security and visible focus.
Use rel=author only when the destination truthfully describes or contacts the nearest article author; email/homepage publication and social/provider choices require target privacy policy.
Omit biography and Links from compact DOM, keep complete text and logical RTL flow, and preserve 320 CSS-pixel reflow, 200-percent text, user text spacing, dark and forced-color operation.
Do not introduce whole-card activation, nested interactive surfaces, person/card roles, menus, status/live announcements, roving focus, loading state or automated fallback behavior.

web.notes: Canonical Blog CSS and shared renderer implement fail-closed neutral semantics, canonical Avatar/Link composition, semantic full/compact omission, intrinsic wrapping and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: A passive snippet maps explicit user or article.user data, requires a name, omits unavailable parts and keeps homepage/email off until explicitly enabled with localized labels. First consumer, contextual placement, privacy approval, role/social extensions and multiple authors remain target-owned.
